crime: {WITCH_NAME} had a regular pool partner. In noisy group games, the partner stood beside her and named one ball and one pocket at a time. {WITCH_NAME} made every precise shot, and their wins kept the partner coming back.

During a quiet practice, {WITCH_NAME} pressed blue cue chalk against the partner's wrist. The partner felt nothing, and no mark appeared. After {WITCH_NAME} stepped into the hall, the partner felt the pressure and a blue mark appeared. The partner's roommate saw and heard everything from the recreation-room doorway without being noticed.

At a midday game, the partner invited several girls to call possible shots at once. Their voices overlapped. {WITCH_NAME} stood motionless with the cue in her hand. The partner took it from her, said she would never choose her shots again, and stayed with the group.

Before evening free time ended, the partner fell asleep on a lounge sofa. The roommate entered and found {WITCH_NAME} alone beside the sleeper, within reach of the wall swords. {WITCH_NAME} left. The roommate woke the partner, saw that the partner was unhurt, and accompanied the partner to the recreation room.

Several girls were gathered around the pool table when a deep stab wound suddenly opened in the partner's chest. No one was touching the partner, and no one held a weapon. The partner collapsed and died. {WITCH_NAME} was not in the room.

The roommate's two sightings, together with the pool-table witnesses' accounts, identified {WITCH_NAME} as the killer. While the partner slept, {WITCH_NAME} drove the point of a lounge sword against the partner's chest and used Deferred Effect to delay the thrust's effect. She returned the sword and left, then released that effect after the partner reached the recreation room.
fields.epitaph: For once, the last moment comes all at once.
execution: Two giant iron hands face each other and seize her standing body between their palms. Her head, torso, arms, and legs are pinned at once, leaving her unable to turn or step away.
The hands close steadily. Pressure crushes her whole body at once; her ribs, pelvis, and skull break between the palms. The hands keep closing until her chest stops moving.

magic.name: Deferred Effect
magic.text: She can defer the effect of an action she performs and make it occur later.
